purpose: StreetUI 2.1 validation-phase environment gate (§1). Captured, not simulated. Every gate below is reported at face value; no unavailable capability is substituted with happy-dom or with published third-party numbers (§16).

browser.reason: No Chromium executable exists on the system. `find /` finds no chrome/chromium/chrome-linux64/headless_shell binary; google-chrome/chromium/chromium-browser are not on PATH; CHROMIUM_PATH and CHROME_PATH are unset; ~/.cache/ms-playwright contains only a stale .links hash entry (no downloaded browser). `playwright install chromium` requires cdn.playwright.dev which is unreachable (npm registry E403 offline). A real chromium.launch() would fail.
browser.notSubstituted: happy-dom models the DOM but is NOT a browser; it is used only for relative-delta Node measurements and is never reported as a browser result.

assistiveTechnology.reason: No screen reader / assistive technology is available in this headless Node VM (no NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver/Orca, no AT-SPI bus, no browser to host one). Accessibility conformance therefore cannot be observed. Static ARIA/role/id derivation is verified in code (deterministic, SSR byte-identical) but that is NOT an AT-conformance pass and is not reported as one.

competitors.reason: Cross-framework browser benchmarking (§15/§16) requires the same real Chromium on the same machine for every framework. Chromium is absent (see browser gate) and the npm registry is E403, so React/Vue/Svelte/Solid cannot be built and launched here. Per §16, missing measurements are null with explicit status; published third-party numbers are NOT used as substitutes.
competitors.preExistingSuspectData: benchmarks/results/{react,vue,svelte,solid}.json and comparison.json (timestamp 2026-09-25) carry competitor numbers labelled domEnvironment='chromium (Playwright)' but with browserVersion=null and nodeVersion='v24.18.0' — a different, unreproducible environment whose provenance is internally inconsistent (a real Playwright run records a browser version). These are NOT used as 2.1 evidence and must not be presented as same-environment competitor measurements. See integrity-note.md.

registry.reason: npm registry is E403 Forbidden in this environment. `streetui` was never published; `npm info streetui version` and `npm create`/generated-from-registry flows cannot run. Consumer validation is done offline from locally packed tarballs instead (§2/§3, clearly labelled).

measuredHere.node_happy_dom: AVAILABLE — relative-delta Node/happy-dom benchmarks and SSR byte-identity are measured in-environment and reported as such (never as browser numbers).
measuredHere.ssrByteIdentity: AVAILABLE — scripts/verify-ssr-hashes.mjs runs fully in Node.
